fact: The woman heard sobbing at night in Baskerville Hall is Mrs. Barrymore.
Barrymore's signals across the moor at night are for the escaped convict Selden, Mrs. Barrymore's brother.
The man Watson sees on the tor is Sherlock Holmes, secretly living on the moor.

fact: Selden dies on the moor, mistaken for Sir Henry.
Stapleton is a Baskerville (he resembles the portrait of Hugo Baskerville).
The hound is a real dog made to glow with phosphorus, and Holmes shoots it dead.
Stapleton dies, lost in the Grimpen Mire.
Stapleton's real name is Rodger Baskerville, son of Sir Charles's younger brother; his wife is Beryl Garcia of Costa Rica.
Stapleton was the bearded man watching from the cab in London.
